# awscc_licensemanagerlinuxsubscriptions_subscription_provider (Resource)

Resource Type definition for AWS::LicenseManagerLinuxSubscriptions::SubscriptionProvider. Registers a third-party Linux subscription provider so that License Manager can retrieve subscription details for the discovered Linux instances in an account.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `secret_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Secrets Manager secret that contains the access token for the third-party Linux subscription provider.
- `subscription_provider_source` (String) The Linux subscription provider that the registration is for.

### Optional

- `tags` (Attributes Set) The metadata tags assigned to the registered subscription provider. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.
- `last_successful_data_retrieval_time` (String) The timestamp from the last time that License Manager retrieved subscription details from the registered third-party Linux subscription provider.
- `subscription_provider_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Linux subscription provider resource that you registered.
- `subscription_provider_status` (String) The status of the third-party subscription provider access token from the last subscription data request.
- `subscription_provider_status_message` (String) A message that describes the status of the third-party subscription provider access token.

<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Optional:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_licensemanagerlinuxsubscriptions_subscription_provider.example
  identity = {
    subscription_provider_arn = "subscription_provider_arn"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `subscription_provider_arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the Linux subscription provider resource that you registered

#### Optional

- `account_id` (String) AWS Account where this resource is managed
- `region` (String) Region where this resource is managed

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = awscc_licensemanagerlinuxsubscriptions_subscription_provider.example
  id = "subscription_provider_arn"
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:
